resolution.evidence: The controller imports only built-in JavaScript and reviewed private QA modules. It refuses Node arguments and ambient Node/tsx/esbuild/dynamic-loader selectors by name. sourcePin, runnerPin and runtimePin precede approvedKey. runtimePin binds the actual Node version/component versions/platform/arch, canonical executable path and SHA256, selected root tsconfig bytes, and the installed dependency tree including file bytes/modes, directories and internal link targets. External links and extra configuration mechanisms are refused. Approval requires equal runtime hash and full details before its sole named credential getter. Worker recomputes source/runner/runtime, checks controller pins and single-use claim, repeats approval before its key getter, then rechecks runtime immediately before absolute installed-loader import. tsx receives the absolute selected config and caching is disabled. Approval template and outputs contain full runtime details.
independentControls: Actual source/runner/runtime pins reproduce assigned values; matching fabricated approval reaches one fabricated getter.

Owned byte copy matches the actual runtime; changing only tsconfig target, tsx entry bytes or zod package bytes changes runtime pin while author HEAD, source, lock and QA stay unchanged; all refuse before fabricated getter/sequential worker/transport counters.
Executable mode and internal symlink changes alter the pin; an external owned symlink refuses; extends refuses.
Coherently wrong Node version and binary pins refuse; same hash with different component details also refuses.
Preload argument and six ambient selector names refuse without reading their getter values.
Preserved old authorize reaches a fabricated getter with mismatched runtime, demonstrating the original gap.
resolution.limits: Trusted plain invocation and ordinary trusted runtime/local filesystem are assumed. A check cannot undo code already preloaded before entry and these checks are not an immutable snapshot against a concurrent malicious filesystem writer. Independent worker/transport counters model sequential reachability; no real worker, loader or provider transport was launched by these focused controls.

resolution.evidence: All source-pin Git execution passes the same frozen literal environment. No parent environment spread occurs. Global/system config and attributes are disabled; per-command settings disable hooks, fsmonitor, external diff and pager, and diff also uses --no-ext-diff/--no-textconv. Helpers use absolute Git, bounded execution/output, exact HEAD, tracked cleanliness and the prior source digest. No host or repository Git settings are changed. The worker key is therefore excluded from these helper environments as well.
independentControls: Real three Git helper calls from actual pins.mjs receive explicit environments; unrelated synthetic sentinel, fake provider key and four synthetic Git selectors are absent in actual /usr/bin/env observations.

Same instrumentation against preserved old core sees omitted env and all six synthetic canaries inherited. Both clean source pins are identical. Only environment names are retained; the entire review process environment is explicitly fabricated/minimal.
